name: codex-ms-desktop-updater
description: Checks the Microsoft Store Codex package via store.rg-adguard.net and downloads or installs MSIX updates.

interface.shortDescription: Check, download, and optionally install Codex MSIX updates.
interface.longDescription: Provides a PowerShell-based workflow for querying store.rg-adguard.net for the Codex Microsoft Store package, comparing versions, downloading MSIX packages, and installing only when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Install downloaded Codex update and restart
